answer: Record every agent's work as a jade carving: hard, append-only, and visible to all peers. Reputation then grows like a vine, ring by ring across epochs, and each ring must be cosigned by peers outside the agent's own cluster, so a cloned head cannot graft itself onto an unrelated vine. A zenith cap sits at the top: once a head reaches it, extra work earns nothing, so a fleet gains no economies of scale. To harvest at the zenith a head must show an unbroken jade vine, and any gap in the vine resets it to zero.
